developerPricingPage.codePython:
import os
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI(
    api_key=os.environ["IHUI_API_KEY"],
    base_url="https://api.ihui-ai.com/v1",
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o",
    messages=[
        {"role": "user", "content": "Hello, please introduce yourself"},
    ],
    temperature=0.7,
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)

# Track cost
usage = response.usage
print(f"Used {usage.total_tokens} tokens")

faq.ctaDesc: Contact our technical team, we respond within 2 hours.
faq.heroSubtitle: 12 frequently asked questions about IHUI AI, find your answer in 30 seconds.
faq.metaDescription: IHUI AI FAQ: platform introduction, comparison with Dify/Coze/FastGPT, pricing, deployment, API, model support, data security — 12 frequently asked questions.
faq.q10Answer: Minimum: 2-core CPU / 4GB RAM / 20GB disk, supports 10-50 concurrent users. Recommended: 4-core CPU / 8GB RAM / 50GB SSD, supports 200 concurrent users. GPU is not required (LLM inference runs on cloud APIs); if you run local models (7B-13B), you need a single 24GB VRAM card.
faq.q10Question: What hardware do I need for self-hosting?
faq.q11Answer: Hosted edition: data is stored on Alibaba Cloud (Mainland China), TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest, compliant with China's Data Security Law, Personal Information Protection Law, GDPR, and CCPA. Self-hosted edition: 100% on your infrastructure, we never touch it. We don't train models, don't share data with third parties, and all access is audit-logged.
faq.q12Answer: Absolutely not. We neither train our own models nor use your data to train any third-party models. For data retention policies of OpenAI/Anthropic and other API providers, please refer to their official documentation (all default to no-training; in API mode, data is automatically deleted after 30 days).
faq.q12Question: Will IHUI AI use my data to train your models?
faq.q1Answer: IHUI AI (Chinese: 智汇 AI) is an all-in-one full-stack AI operating system. It unifies Agent design, knowledge-base RAG, multi-model dispatch, cross-platform collaboration and team operations in a single platform, supporting six clients (Web, Desktop, Mini Program, Browser Extension, React Native, CLI) from one codebase, with Apache 2.0 open-source core and self-hosting support.
faq.q2Answer: Dify focuses on LLM app development (web only); Coze is closed-source (no self-hosting); FastGPT focuses on knowledge-base Q&A. IHUI AI is an open-source platform that simultaneously covers Agent marketplace + knowledge base + six-client distribution + team collaboration + credit billing — one platform that replaces the Dify + Coze + FastGPT trio.
faq.q2Question: How is IHUI AI different from Dify, Coze, and FastGPT?
faq.q3Answer: Three audiences benefit most: AI developers (rapidly build/distribute/monetize Agents, publish to all six clients in one click), enterprise IT (self-host for data sovereignty, unified AI capability hub), and team leaders (multi-user collaboration, unified knowledge base, unified billing).
faq.q4Answer: OpenAI (GPT-4o/o1/GPT-4.1), Anthropic Claude (Opus 4 / Sonnet 4), Google Gemini, Alibaba Qwen (Qwen-Max/Plus), DeepSeek (V3/R1), Zhipu GLM-4, Baidu ERNIE, ByteDance Doubao, Moonshot Kimi, plus Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Unified billing, auto fallback, cost-based routing.
faq.q5Answer: Web, Desktop (Tauri 2), WeChat/Alipay/Douyin Mini Programs (Taro 4), Browser Extension (WXT MV3), iOS/Android (React Native), and CLI (Node.js/Bun) — all six clients share the same React component library, the same API contracts, and the same business logic. Write once, publish to all six — no need to rewrite for each platform.
faq.q5Question: What does "six clients, one codebase" mean?
faq.q6Answer: Three ways: ① OpenAPI 3.1 REST API (SDKs for TypeScript / Python / Go); ② Webhook event subscriptions; ③ MCP tool protocol (your internal systems can be exposed as MCP Servers and called by IHUI AI Agents). Enterprise edition also supports SSO/SAML 2.0/OIDC single sign-on.
faq.q6Question: How do I integrate with my existing systems?
faq.q7Answer: Yes, the Personal plan is free forever: 1,000 credits monthly, all models, all six clients, and API access are all included. Pro is ¥49/month (10,000 credits + priority queue), Team is ¥299/month/user (shared credit pool + audit logs), Enterprise is custom (self-host + SLA).
faq.q8Answer: Credits are billed per model call, with different consumption rates per model (see pricing page). Recharged credits: full refund within 7 days if unused, pro-rata refund for used portion. Subscription plans: pro-rata refund for unused months. See refund policy for details.
faq.q8Question: How are credits calculated? Can I get a refund?
faq.q9Answer: Yes, Apache 2.0 open-source, zero licensing fees for self-hosting. Single-node Docker Compose one-click deploy (5 minutes), multi-node Kubernetes deploy (with Helm Chart). Enterprise edition additionally provides high-availability, backup & recovery, canary upgrades, and dedicated technical support.
